finding.title: Route AppErrorView/ErrorDisplay/PinEntryWidget user-facing strings through AppLocalizations instead of hardcoded English
finding.why: This is a Hebrew-first RTL app (docs/hebrew-terms.md, device-locale Hebrew testing in project memory), yet these 3 core widgets never call AppLocalizations — 18 literal English occurrences across the 3 files. AppErrorView is the documented canonical replacement for ad-hoc error UI and is used from 16+ screens (dashboard, learning, bulk-mark, profile-picker among them); ErrorDisplay is live in 4 progress screens; PinEntryWidget gates every parent-mode entry. Any Hebrew-locale user who goes offline, hits a permission error, or mistypes the parent PIN 3 times sees raw English text ("Too many failed attempts", "Retry", "Something went wrong") embedded in an otherwise-Hebrew UI. This isn't a missing-infrastructure gap: app_en.arb already has `actionRetry: "Retry"` (line 1122) and an ICU-ready `tutorPinLockedOut: "Too many attempts. Locked for {minutes} minute(s)."` (line 2765) for the exact lockout-countdown case — the existing keys are simply not called. Line 163's `subtitle: error.message` additionally pipes a raw `AppException.message` (declared as "Human-readable description" in app_exception.dart) straight to the UI, which is exactly what EH-5 forbids.
finding.recommendation: Thread AppLocalizations into AppErrorView._configFor (pass context/l10n in), replace error_display.dart's literal 'Retry' with l10n.actionRetry, and replace pin_entry_widget.dart's 4 literals with new/existing ARB keys (reuse the tutorPinLockedOut ICU pattern for the minute(s) string). Convert ValidationException to a stable code/enum resolved via ARB rather than surfacing .message directly.
acceptance_criteria: AppErrorView, ErrorDisplay, and PinEntryWidget contain zero raw Text('...') English literals — verifiable by a grep/lint (e.g. a working `no_hardcoded_domain_term`-style custom_lint or a Rule-0 grep for quoted capitalized strings in Text() calls under core/widgets).
EN/HE ARB parity check (`make arb-parity`) still passes 1421/1421 after new keys are added.

test/core/widgets/app_error_view_test.dart, error_display_test.dart, pin_entry_widget_test.dart updated to assert against resolved l10n values or widget keys, not literal English — and fail red if a literal is reintroduced.
ValidationException.message no longer reaches AppErrorView's subtitle directly; a stable code/enum is resolved via AppLocalizations instead.
